punchlist.title: The Conquest is nearly silent
The first time any sound outside the core eleven is needed, it is dropped
The desktop app has no voices at all, no UI sounds, no sound settings
Voices: 0 of 1007 recorded; what plays is the browser's speech synthesiser, on by default
Nothing that moves makes a sound
The satchel fuse is never played, a laid satchel is silent, and fire has no sound after the burst
The player's own orders and errors have no sound of their own
Before the first tick there is no sound: title, Skirmish setup, town screen, deployment
Gates, walls, engines at work and water are silent; the features now being built have no hooks
A third of the effects are almost entirely below 300 Hz
Ambience sits 12 to 20 dB under the fighting and may not be heard at all
The distance curve silences the game at the heights it is played at
Machine-gun repeats and hard cut-offs in any real fight; worse at 2×, 4×, 8×
There is no real limiter on the web, and the desktop's distorts everything
Swings and launches are timed after the event they announce
Fifty-five of 168 files are more than 1.5 dB from their loudness target, and variants of one sound differ by up to 3.4 dB
Several sounds are spectrally unlike what they are named for
Variants of some sounds are near copies
War drums: a 4.8 s loop that plays for any enemy 40-300 m from any of ours, whichever way he is going
Browser and iPhone handling: sound keeps going in a hidden tab; the ring switch mutes it
The desktop mix is not the web mix
Victory and defeat: one synthesised take each, the most exposed sounds in the game
Loops are 10 s with 5-7 dB of movement inside them
Rain and thunder cannot be reached by a player
The button click plays at about -39 LUFS, is 8 ms long, and goes through a battle strip
Pan at the close camera is by angle, not distance
Only one file clips, and it is not played yet:
Encoding
Voice and effect targets differ
Cries repeat
The test page cannot audition what matters most
Documents disagree
